data.title: You can give us 2% of your taxes
data.excerpt: In 2014 the Hradiská civic association is applying for 2% of your taxes. If a sufficient sum is collected we shall be able to publish a volume of scholarly articles by archaeologists on Slavic hillforts and the history of the Slavs, and we shall also continue to work on information panels at hillforts.
data.metaTitle: You can give us 2% of your taxes (2014)
data.metaDescription: In 2014 the Hradiská civic association is applying for 2% of your taxes — for a planned volume on Slavic hillforts and for new information panels.

children.text:
The Hradiská civic association is applying for 2% of your taxes in 2014.
 
 If you would like to support us, you can use this form:

the idea was raised that we might publish a volume, or rather a monograph, of scholarly articles by archaeologists on the subject of Slavic hillforts and the history of the Slavs. If we manage to collect a sufficient sum of money, this plan of ours will not remain a mere idea and we shall really be able to carry it out.
 
 In 2014 we shall also continue to work on information panels at hillforts. Here are our previous panels from 2013:
Likewise, anyone who would be interested in sending us a financial gift can send any sum to account number
